evals.title: Patient switch with open order
evals.prompt: A clinician has an order panel open and switches patients in the underlying chart. Design safe behavior.
evals.expected_output: Panel closes or re-scopes explicitly; stale patient/action state cannot persist invisibly.
assertions: Patient/object/action scope is explicit.
Consequential semantic states are not conflated.
High-consequence state is not color-only.
Missing/partial/stale/unavailable states are explicit.
Confirmation, when used, states object + action + consequence.
Context switching cannot leave stale actionable state.
